data_objects.name: storm_records
data_objects.meaning: Named storm-event records with activity dates, intensity fields, affected areas, damage, deaths, and year.

variables.name: name
variables.meaning: Storm name or source event label.

variables.name: dates_active
variables.meaning: Text date span during which the storm was active.

variables.name: areas_affected
variables.meaning: Comma-delimited text listing places affected by the storm.

variables.name: damage_USD
variables.meaning: Estimated storm damage amount denominated in United States dollars.

variables.name: deaths
variables.meaning: Recorded number of deaths associated with the storm.

variables.name: year
variables.meaning: Calendar year associated with the storm record.

variables.name: damage_imputed
variables.meaning: Binary flag indicating whether the damage value was imputed.

structure.description: Each ordinary row represents one storm event; name, year, and dates_active provide event-identifying context, while areas_affected stores multiple places in one text cell.

uncertainties: The category scale, wind-speed unit, and pressure unit are not specified.
The valuation basis and reference-year convention for damage_USD are not documented.
annotation_notes: Damage currency is explicit in the source name; other physical units remain unresolved.
